# AI for Sales — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Map your week

*Module 1: Where the hours go · about 10 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_map_your_week.py`): Fill WEEK with your own real week (be honest). What share is research and typing? What will you do with the hours you get back?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Brief on a live prospect

*Module 2: Account research · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_account_brief.py`): Build a brief on a live prospect using only facts you can source. Mark every line with where it came from.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Three variants, pick and edit

*Module 3: Outreach in your voice · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_outreach_in_your_voice.py`): Paste three of your own best emails as the exemplar, write your banned-phrase list, and test a draft. What did it catch?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Call → CRM → follow-up

*Module 4: Calls to CRM · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_call_to_crm.py`): Use the transcript of a real call (names changed). Which CRM fields stayed empty? Those are your questions for the next call.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 5 — Proposal draft

*Module 5: Proposals and objections · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 5** (`python demos/05_proposal_and_objections.py`): Add your three most common objections and your best answers to data/objections.md. Test them with the wording customers really use.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 6 — 5 prompts per pipeline stage

*Module 6: Guardrails and playbook · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 6** (`python demos/06_guardrails_playbook.py`): Write one prompt per pipeline stage for your own team. Run the guardrail on a real draft before it goes out.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
